## Why it matters

The answer says how many samples a given accuracy costs.

## What would settle it

The RMS error over many seeds, at several sample sizes, fitted on a log-log scale.

## What would make us drop it

An error that does not shrink as the sample grows.

## Answer

Yes, see `R-4` and `C-1`.
